review_notes: I read the whole file and the simp lemmas it depends on in Product/Basic.lean. Those lemmas are orderedProdRealizationMap_fst_val, orderedProdRealizationMap_snd_val and orderedProdRealizationMap_vertex. They are already tagged @[simp] and oriented toward the canonical form, Finsupp.mapDomain Prod.fst x.1. The file adds no simp lemmas or definitions of its own. Its two proofs use targeted `simpa only` with those lemmas, which is appropriate. I found no competing rules, no unwanted expansion and no plausible rewrite cycle. Homeomorph.lean uses the same lemmas the same way. I did not find enough evidence to recommend a new simp lemma, for example one for the Subtype-level projection, since that would be recommending simp solely because an identity looks simple. I did not run Lean, so I observed no simplifier behavior.
